CLAUDE.md

Source: CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

What this is

zurds reads R’s serialization format (.rds, .rda/.RData, serialize() raw vectors, lazy-load .rdb/.rdx databases) without handing it to R’s deserializer. It reports headers, lists the objects in an .rda, summarises structure, extracts one object, scans for anything that can run code or reach outside the file, and reads data-only files with a C reader that never calls unserialize(). It has no hard runtime dependencies; zufast is LinkingTo only. It never re-implements R’s deserializer for closures, environments or bytecode, and reads no other format.

.agents/design.md is the specification and outranks this file. .agents/roadmap.md stages the work to 0.1.0, tracked in v0.1.0 #1.

Current state

Stages 0 to 2, 2026-10-10: zurds_info(), the condition classes, symbol hiding and its gate; the source that opens a path, raw vector or connection and reads decompressed bytes; the fixture generator; and the walk over XDR streams of data items (vectors, strings, lists, pairlists, attributes, symbols, references) with its limits. Closures, environments, bytecode, ALTREP and the binary and ASCII formats are refused as “not walked yet”. No user-facing function beyond zurds_info() yet; the tests drive the internal zrd_walk_info().

Stage tracking

  • One parent issue per target version: v0.1.0 (#1).
  • One sub-issue per roadmap stage, titled as the roadmap titles it, with the stage label.
  • Close a stage by merging its pull request, with Closes #<n> in the body. Never close a stage whose exit criteria are not met; record a deviation in the roadmap first.
  • The roadmap stays authoritative. The issues record which stages are done.

Versioning

Develops at 0.0.0.9000 and targets 0.1.0 for its first CRAN release (Stage 12). Bump to 0.1.0.9000 only after CRAN accepts it.

Commands

Run from the package root.

Rscript -e 'devtools::load_all()'                # compile src/ and load
Rscript -e 'devtools::document()'                # roxygen -> NAMESPACE, man/
Rscript -e 'devtools::test()'                    # full testthat suite
Rscript -e 'devtools::test(shuffle = TRUE)'      # order independence
Rscript -e 'devtools::check()'                   # R CMD check
air format .                                     # format R sources
tools/check-symbols <path/to/zurds.so>           # on an R CMD INSTALL build
tools/check-symbols --canary                     # the gate must reject this
Rscript tools/make-fixtures.R                    # rewrite tests/testthat/fixtures
Rscript tools/make-fixtures.R --full DIR         # the full matrix, into DIR
ZURDS_FIXTURES=DIR Rscript -e 'devtools::test()' # the suite against DIR
tools/run-standalone [DIR]                       # the walk without R, sanitized
Rscript tools/alloc-exercise.R                   # what alloc-failure.yaml sweeps

Architecture

See design §4. Every user-facing function starts with zrd_open() in R/source.R: it detects compression from the file’s magic bytes, opens the file with gzfile() (which decompresses everything R writes), wraps the connection or raw vector in a zrd_source external pointer, and detects the kind from the first decompressed bytes. src/zrd_reader.c is the R-free buffered reader the walk consumes; src/zrd_source.c is the R side that fills it with R_ReadConnection(). src/zrd_walk.c is the walk: one frame per open item on an explicit stack of max_depth + 1 frames, a step() loop that begins the next child or ends the item, and BEGIN/END events to a callback. A pairlist’s next cell reuses its frame, so long pairlists do not deepen the stack. src/zrd_walk_r.c runs it from R with the walk owned by an external pointer; R/walk.R maps its status to a condition class. src/init.c registers .Call routines and is the only exported symbol. Internal C symbols use the zrd_ / ZRD_ prefix. The walk (src/zrd_walk.c, from Stage 2) is R-free and must compile with -DZRD_STANDALONE; the data builder (src/zrd_build.c) is the only place R objects are made from stream content. R-side conditions are built in R/conditions.R by zrd_abort(); the class chain lives in zrd_condition_classes. Default limits live in zrd_default_limits().

Invariants that are easy to break

  • src/Makevars lists every object by hand (portable make) and sets $(C_VISIBILITY). A new .c file not listed is silently not built; a non-static function without hidden visibility fails tools/check-symbols.
  • The walk never allocates an R object or calls R. Anything R-specific goes behind #ifndef ZRD_STANDALONE.
  • Limits are checked before a length from the file is trusted, never after.
  • An unknown pseudo-type is a parse error, never a skip.
  • R’s codecs do not fail loudly on truncated input: through gzfile(), gzip reads short, bzip2 and zstd read nothing, and xz warns. R/source.R checks the gzip trailer’s ISIZE, the xz footer and empty output, and turns codec warnings into zurds_decompression_error. Read source bytes only through zrd_source_call(), or a codec warning escapes as a plain warning.
  • Never decompress input with memDecompress(): with zlib (Linux R without libdeflate) it doubles its buffer forever on truncated gzip, and the process is killed. Compressed raw vectors go through a temporary file and gzfile() instead.
  • Every walk rule cites the serialize.c function it mirrors (commit a97c000). Keep the citation when changing a rule; Stage 10’s drift check depends on it.
  • Native routine names are R objects in the namespace (useDynLib with .registration = TRUE). An R function with the same name as a .Call routine shadows it; the R wrappers use different names (zrd_walk_info() calls zrd_walk_stats).
  • Gates need canaries: a new gate is trusted only once it has failed on a planted defect.

Testing conventions

  • Self-sufficient tests: each builds its inputs inside test_that().
  • Global state through withr::local_*(); write only under tempdir().
  • Assert on condition classes, never message text.
  • devtools::test(shuffle = TRUE) is part of done.
  • The oracle is R itself: fixtures are written by tools/make-fixtures.R, and data-only reads must be identical() to readRDS(). Tests iterate over fixture_manifest() (helper-fixtures.R), so they run on the small checked-in set by default and on the full matrix when ZURDS_FIXTURES is set. Never edit tests/testthat/fixtures/ by hand; regenerate it.

Definition of done

devtools::document() and devtools::check() clean (0 errors, warnings, notes). devtools::test(shuffle = TRUE) green. gctorture(TRUE) clean when C changed. CI green on every leg. A user-facing change needs a test, roxygen documentation and a NEWS.md entry.

Releasing to CRAN

CI through pedrobtz/r-actions is the pre-submission check; no win-builder, macOS builder or R-hub. Fix NOTEs rather than explaining them. Remotes: pedrobtz/zufast stays until zufast is on CRAN (Stage 12).

Editing rules

  • roxygen is the source; never edit man/ or NAMESPACE by hand.
  • Keep prose short. en-GB spelling. Wrap roxygen at 80 characters.
  • lower_snake_case; R prefix rds_ for exports, zrd_ internal.
  • A stage that settles a design decision or open question edits .agents/design.md in the same pull request.

Continuous integration

Calls pedrobtz/r-actions at @v1: r-cmd-check.yml (R-CMD-check), coverage.yml, and in native-checks.yaml sanitizers.yml, valgrind.yml, lto.yml, gctorture.yml, rchk.yml (with github-packages: pedrobtz/zufast), analyzers.yml, cran-special.yml. gates.yaml runs tools/check-symbols and its canary, and tools/run-standalone over the full fixture matrix. arch.yaml (32-bit, musl) and alloc-failure.yaml (fails each allocation of tools/alloc-exercise.R) run weekly. fixtures.yaml regenerates the fixtures on oldrel, release and devel, checks the checked-in manifest, and runs the suite on the full matrix.

Commits and pull requests

Short, imperative, sentence-case subjects. One pull request per roadmap stage, titled as the stage. Never commit to main directly.
